_comment: PRIX-1 — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the MIA subscription price. ONE paid plan, two billing cadences, US dollars everywhere (including Canadian customers). Amounts are whole USD. `annualPerMonth` is DERIVED (annualPerYear / 12) — never write it by hand. Edit here, then regenerate the frontend module: `node scripts/gen_pricing.mjs`. The backend reads THIS file directly (src/billing/pricing.py). No amount may be hard-coded anywhere else. No tax is ever added or displayed. No struck-through price, no discount, no countdown.
